## Selected publications

[Download BibTeX](publications.bib){.bib-download} — 精選著作的引用資料，可直接匯入文獻管理軟體。

::: {.pub-card}
[Co-corresponding author]{.pub-badge}

[2023 · Science Advances]{.pub-meta}

#### [Topological screen identifies hundreds of Cp190- and CTCF-dependent *Drosophila* chromatin insulator elements](https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.ade0090)

Tatyana G Kahn, Mikhail Savitsky, Chikuan Kuong, Caroline Jacquier, Giacomo Cavalli, **Jia-Ming Chang**\*, Yuri B Schwartz\*

::: {.pub-why}
A topological screen in *Drosophila* cells lacking CTCF and Cp190 identifies hundreds of insulator elements that modulate local chromatin interactions without driving global genome folding, suggesting Cp190 functions by promoting insulator protein cobinding rather than loop formation.
:::

:::

::: {.pub-card}
[First author]{.pub-badge}

[2021 · Bioinformatics]{.pub-meta}

#### [Incorporating alignment uncertainty into Felsenstein's phylogenetic bootstrap to improve its reliability](https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btz082)

**Jia-Ming Chang**, Evan W Floden, Javier Herrero, Olivier Gascuel, Paolo Di Tommaso, Cedric Notredame

::: {.pub-why}
Sampling alignment columns across alternative aligners enhances the discriminative power of bootstrap support regarding tree topology correctness.
:::

:::

::: {.pub-card}
[Corresponding author]{.pub-badge}

[2019 · BMC Genomics]{.pub-meta}

#### [MS2CNN: predicting MS/MS spectrum based on protein sequence using deep convolutional neural networks](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12864-019-6297-6)

Yang-Ming Lin, Ching-Tai Chen, **Jia-Ming Chang**\*

::: {.pub-why}
Predicted MS2 spectra improve the sensitivity and coverage of peptide identification. MS2CNN was among the first deep-learning approaches to this problem, outperforming MS2PIP, matching pDeep overall, and performing best on the hardest 3+ charge peptides.
:::

:::

::: {.pub-card}
[First author]{.pub-badge}

[2014 · Molecular Biology and Evolution]{.pub-meta}

#### [TCS: A New Multiple Sequence Alignment Reliability Measure to Estimate Alignment Accuracy and Improve Phylogenetic Tree Reconstruction](https://doi.org/10.1093/molbev/msu117)

**Jia-Ming Chang**, Paolo Di Tommaso, Cedric Notredame

::: {.pub-why}
The reliability of a multiple sequence alignment can be robustly quantified using the Transitive Consistency Score, derived from the T-Coffee pairwise library.
:::

:::

::: {.pub-card}
[First author]{.pub-badge}

[2012 · BMC Bioinformatics]{.pub-meta}

#### [Accurate Multiple Sequence Alignment of Transmembrane Proteins with PSI-Coffee](https://doi.org/10.1186/1471-2105-13-s4-s1)

**Jia-Ming Chang**, Paolo Di Tommaso, Jean-François F Taly, Cedric Notredame

::: {.pub-why}
Homology extension combined with a consistency-based approach significantly improves the multiple sequence alignment of alpha-helical transmembrane proteins.
:::

:::
